Why does q have a u after it?

explain.say: Look at p. The line comes first, going down. Then the bump sits on the right, at the top. That is p, as in pen and pizza. Can you draw it on your hand with one finger?

explain.say: Now look at q. The bump comes first, like a c. Then the line goes down. And q has a best friend: u. They almost always go together. Can you remember q and its friend?

explain.say: See the word queen? The q and u stand together and make one sound, the first sound in quick. So when you see q, look for the u right after it. Can you spot it?
Look at the words sorted on the board. Every q word has a u next to it. Well done for spotting that! Challenge: how many things starting with p can you find in your room?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: Does it start with p or q?

faq.a: p has its line first, going down, then the bump on the right. Say pen as you draw the line, then add the bump.
q starts with a c shape, then the line goes down. And q nearly always has u after it, like in queen and quick.

faq.q: Why does q always have a u after it?
faq.a: In English, q is almost always followed by u, and together they usually make a kw sound. A few names from other languages, like Qatar, break the rule.
asks: Why is there a u after q?

faq.q: What if I still mix them up?
faq.a: That is okay. Look for the u: if there is a u after it, it is probably q. A teacher or grown-up can make you a little card with p and q to check.
asks: I still mix up p and q

faq.q: Can moving my body help me remember?
faq.a: Yes! Draw p and q really big in the air with your whole arm, and say the sound as you go. Moving helps your brain remember the shape.
asks: How can I practise p and q?

facts: In English words, the letter q is almost always followed by u.
The letters p and q are mirror images of each other, and both hang below the writing line.

quiz.say: Which letter almost always has u after it?
quiz.show: Which letter nearly always has u next?
quiz.why: q and u are best friends, like in queen and quick.

wrong.0: p can go with any letter, like in pen and pig.
wrong.2: d can go with any letter, like in dog and dad.

quiz.why: Pen starts with p: the line first, then the bump on the right.

wrong.0: Queen starts with q, and you can see its friend u.
